text_block_list.text:
When I went to the rooftop during lunch break,
Meisho Doto was standing there...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Buuurp... I-If I drink this much,
it should definitely get rid of the sluggishness...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Heeek!? T-T-T-Trainer-san!? This energy drink is, um, well—
choice_data_list: That's a sports drink, you know?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Whaaaat!?
I didn't even realize I drank this much~!!
